meta.source: Sources/Glamor/macOS/Tokens.swift and Sources/Glamor/iOS/Tokens+iOS.swift (enum G); seeded from komando-apps 2026-11-18

color.note: Each token is a member of the Swift enum G (G.cardHover is --cardHover). Light and dark follow the system, or the person's choice in the profile menu.

tokens.name: window
tokens.usage: G.window. Behind everything: the window itself and the sidebar that sits on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: G.panel. The floating content panel, the command palette, and the selected sidebar row.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: G.card. Cards, secondary buttons and the command bar. In light it equals panel, so the hairline border does the separating.

tokens.name: cardHover
tokens.usage: G.cardHover. A raised control under the pointer: a secondary button, a MenuPicker, a HoverCard, the profile row, the sidebar Search; a chosen chip.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: G.subtle. Quiet fills: code and output surfaces, the active tab, a raised control while pressed.

tokens.name: hover-card
tokens.usage: G.Hover.onCard. An item under the pointer on a card: a list row, a table row, the ⋯, a ghost button in a card. 1.10:1 on card in both themes (dark was subtle, 1.04:1); text3 holds 4.5:1 on it. With Increase Contrast 1.23 / 1.27:1.

tokens.name: hover-panel
tokens.usage: G.Hover.onPanel. An item under the pointer on the panel: menu and palette rows, side-list rows, tabs, chips, ghost buttons. 1.10 / 1.12:1; with Increase Contrast 1.23 / 1.30:1.

tokens.name: hover-tab
tokens.usage: G.Hover.onTab. A panel-header tab under the pointer: 1.06:1 on panel in both themes, quieter than the active tab's subtle (which also has its marker).

tokens.name: hover-window
tokens.usage: G.Hover.onWindow. A sidebar place or the More row under the pointer: 1.06:1 in both themes (dark was 1.035), still quieter than the chosen place's panel, border and marker.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: G.Hover.pressed. Any item or raised control while the mouse is down, one step past hover. Nothing fades on press. text3 sits at 4.2:1 on it only during the press.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: G.field. Text fields, the search bar and the sidebar search button. Darker than card in dark, so inputs read as wells.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: G.border. Every decorative hairline: card outlines, list separators, the dashed section divider, the empty part of a progress bar. Decorative (1.3:1), never the only thing marking a control: controls use controlEdge.

tokens.name: controlEdge
tokens.usage: G.controlEdge. The outline of a thing that is a control: the off switch track, an unchecked checkbox, a text field's outline. 3:1 or more on every surface: light 3.35:1 on card and field, 3.0:1 on window; dark 3.3:1 on card, 3.7:1 on field, 3.0:1 on cardHover.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: G.text. Titles, row names and values on window, panel, card, subtle and cardHover: 15:1 or more in light, 12.5:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: G.text2. Secondary text: subtitles, help under a title, unselected sidebar rows and tabs, labels in an info row. 7.2:1 or more on every surface in light, 7.3:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: text3
tokens.usage: G.text3. Tertiary: timestamps, counts, shortcut hints, placeholders, inline icons. 4.5:1 or more on every surface in both themes, the pressed fill included (lowest: 4.57:1 on pressed in light, 4.60:1 on pressed in dark), so it may carry small text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: G.accent. Focus rings, the command bar’s prompt and run button, new-item icons. As text 4.8:1 or more on every surface in light and dark, and 4.63:1 (light) and 4.65:1 (dark) inside its own pill. With Increase Contrast the pill tint is 16%, so accent darkens in light and lightens in dark (increased): 4.61:1 (light) and 4.62:1 (dark) inside its 16% pill, 5.93:1 and 6.06:1 on card.

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: G.onAccent. A glyph or word on an accent fill, such as the agent's send button: 5.4:1 in light, 6.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: G.focus. The keyboard focus ring around a button, chip, sidebar place, tab, list row or card: a line-strong (2pt) line with a focus-offset (2pt) gap. Around a control: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: r + 4).strokeBorder(G.focus, lineWidth: 2).padding(-4). Inside a full-width list row in a clipped CardList: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: G.Radius.r4).strokeBorder(G.focus, lineWidth: 2).padding(2). 4.8:1 or more against what surrounds it in both themes (dark on cardHover 4.86:1). Fields keep their own focus-ring.

tokens.name: selected-marker
tokens.usage: G.selectedMarker. The one mark of a chosen item, so selection never rests on a fill alone (1.04 to 1.11:1): a line-strong (2pt) bar, radius-full, at the leading edge of a selected sidebar place or list row (16 high, centred), under the active panel-header tab, and as the 1pt ring of a selected chip. Against the fill it sits on: 4.4:1 or more light (a list row's 10% accent), 4.6:1 or more dark.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: G.primary. The one black (in dark, white) main button: Add, Save, Check Again. One per view.

tokens.name: primaryHover
tokens.usage: G.primaryHover. The primary button under the pointer: primary mixed 88% toward onPrimary, opaque so the ground never shows through. onPrimary on it 11.9 / 12.5:1.

tokens.name: primaryPressed
tokens.usage: G.primaryPressed. The primary button while pressed (80%). onPrimary on it 9.0 / 10.4:1.

tokens.name: onPrimary
tokens.usage: G.onPrimary. Label and shortcut badge on a primary fill (17:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: G.ok. Healthy, up, done: status dots, check icons, full progress bars, the Free pill on the Upgrade sheet. As text 4.8:1 or more on every surface in light (4.66:1 inside its pill) and 6.6:1 or more in dark. Always beside a word: Up, Open, Free. With Increase Contrast (16% pill) light darkens to #227440: 4.61:1 inside its pill; dark keeps #45c46a at 5.43:1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: G.warn. Needs attention, protected, partly done: the dot, the attention card’s line and border, the lock on a protected target. A burnt orange in light so its text stays readable: 4.9:1 on every surface, 4.7:1 inside its pill, 4.6:1 on the attention card; 7.1:1 or more in dark. With Increase Contrast (16% pill) light darkens to #a84600: 4.65:1 inside its pill; dark keeps #f2a445 at 5.78:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: G.danger. Failed, stopped, not answering: the error banner’s icon and tint, a stopped forward, a failed doctor check. As text 4.9:1 or more in light and 4.8:1 or more in dark (4.68:1 inside its pill in light, 4.64:1 in dark). With Increase Contrast (16% pill) it darkens to #bd252b in light and lightens to #f47478 in dark: 4.66:1 and 4.65:1 inside its pill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Black at 18% behind the command palette, in both themes.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: G.avatar. The avatar's one solid fill (no gradient). The same in both themes (the light ok value), so the white initial is 5.33:1 in dark too.

tokens.name: onAvatar
tokens.usage: G.onAvatar. The initial on the avatar: 5.3:1.

tokens.name: tint-servers
tokens.usage: Family.servers.tint: server.rack tiles. Glyph on its own 12% tile: 3.8:1 light, 4.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: tint-databases
tokens.usage: Family.databases.tint: cylinder.split.1x2 tiles. 4.3:1 light, 4.5:1 dark on its tile.

tokens.name: tint-caches
tokens.usage: Family.caches.tint: memorychip tiles. On its own 12% tile: 3.45:1 light (3.1:1 over subtle, cardHover and window), 5.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: tint-storage
tokens.usage: Family.storage.tint: archivebox tiles and port-forward cards. Glyph on its own 12% tile: 3.47:1 light (3.16:1 over subtle, cardHover and window), 6:1 dark.

tokens.name: tint-clusters
tokens.usage: Family.clusters.tint: circle.hexagongrid tiles and job cards. 4.7:1 light, 4.5:1 dark on its tile.

tokens.name: tint-registries
tokens.usage: Family.registries.tint: shippingbox tiles. 3.46:1 light (3.15:1 over subtle, cardHover and window), 5.9:1 dark on its tile.

tokens.name: tint-queues
tokens.usage: Family.queues.tint: tray.full tiles for message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS JetStream, Amazon SQS, Google Pub/Sub). Glyph on its own 12% tile: 5.03:1 light over panel and card, 4.56:1 or more over subtle, cardHover and window; 4.62:1 or more dark on every surface.

tokens.name: tint-vpns
tokens.usage: Family.vpns.tint: network.badge.shield.half.filled tiles. The same green as ok. 4.5:1 light, 5.8:1 dark on its tile.

tokens.name: tint-other
tokens.usage: Family.other.tint: questionmark.circle tiles for kinds Komando does not know. 3.44:1 light (3.11:1 over subtle, cardHover and window), 4.3:1 dark on its tile.

tokens.name: logo-ground-top
tokens.usage: The logo square’s graphite, at the top. The mark is the same in both themes.

tokens.name: logo-ground-bottom
tokens.usage: The logo square’s graphite, at the bottom.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: The logo’s K arms: 12:1 to 17:1 on the graphite.

tokens.name: logo-cursor
tokens.usage: The logo’s stem, which is the cursor: the dark accent, 4.4:1 to 6:1 on the graphite (a graphic, so 3:1 applies).

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: G.terminalBackground. Behind a terminal session. Follows the app theme; a hair off panel in light so a session reads as its own surface.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text: an alias of text (16:1 on term-bg in both themes).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Terminal faint text (SGR 2) and the prompt’s path: an alias of text3 (4.9:1 light, 5.8:1 dark on term-bg).

tokens.name: term-cursor
tokens.usage: The block cursor and the active pane’s top rule: an alias of accent.

tokens.name: term-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text in a terminal; term-fg stays 11:1 or more on it.

tokens.name: ansi-black
tokens.usage: ANSI black (color 0), on term-bg 16:1 light, 4.5:1 dark. In dark it is the darkest grey that still reads, kept darker than bright black (ansi-bright-black).

tokens.name: ansi-bright-black
tokens.usage: ANSI bright black (color 8), on term-bg 5.3:1 light, 6.4:1 dark: the same values as text3.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: ANSI red, on term-bg 5.5:1 light, 7.5:1 dark. The command line prints errors in it, the same meaning as danger.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: ANSI green, 5.2:1 light, 9.9:1 dark. The command line prints ok in it, the same meaning as ok.

tokens.name: ansi-yellow
tokens.usage: ANSI yellow, 5.4:1 light, 11.3:1 dark. Warnings in the command line, the same meaning as warn.

tokens.name: ansi-blue
tokens.usage: ANSI blue, 5.2:1 light, 7.8:1 dark. Directories and links.

tokens.name: ansi-magenta
tokens.usage: ANSI magenta, 5.4:1 light, 8.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI cyan, 5.1:1 light, 10.4:1 dark. The prompt’s host name.

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Six sizes in the whole product: 11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 20. No half sizes, no system text styles (.caption, .callout, .title2), which change with macOS settings. Line heights are multiples of 4; in SwiftUI the container sets the height and the text is centred in it.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Font.system(size: 20, weight: .semibold). Form and sheet titles beside a 48 tile. Was 20.

styles.name: title-m
styles.usage: Font.system(size: 17, weight: .semibold). The panel header title, a target’s name in its detail header, the app name in the sidebar. Was 17 and 18.

styles.name: title-s
styles.usage: Font.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold). Section titles, empty-state titles, panel titles. Was 15 and 16.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: 13 is the body size. Weight, not size, marks emphasis.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, the primary button, menu and toggle titles, a selected sidebar row or tab. Was 13 and 13.5 semibold.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Field labels and the secondary button. Was 13 medium.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything else: sidebar rows, info rows, table cells, inputs, the search bar. Was 13, 13.5 and 14.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: A server you reach over SSH · 2 days ago
styles.usage: Help under fields, subtitles and metadata under rows, banners, chips, the status bar. Was 11.5, 12 and 12.5.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Pills, shortcut badges, table headers. Was 10, 10.5, 11 and 11.5.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: Sidebar and panel section labels, in capitals.

styles.name: input-l
styles.sample: Find a target, a place, or connect to user@address
styles.usage: The command palette’s field only. Was 16.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: SF Mono through Font.system(design: .monospaced). The terminal starts at mono-l and steps through term-font-sizes (11, 12, 13, 15, 17, 20, 24, 28) with Bigger Text and Smaller Text: G.Terminal.fontSizes.

styles.name: mono-l
styles.usage: G.monoLarge: the command bar, mono fields, the terminal.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: G.mono: output, commands on cards, table cells with ids and times.

styles.name: mono-s
styles.usage: Ratios beside a bar. Was 10.5, 11 and 11.5.

groups.name: iPhone and iPad
groups.note: Owner decision 2026-11-12: the phone's type is built on iOS text styles, so every size grows with Dynamic Type. At the default text size each style lands on the product's six sizes (20, 17, 15, 13, 12, 11); line heights are the system's. The Mac keeps fixed sizes and no system text styles.

styles.name: ios-title
styles.usage: Font.system(.title3, .semibold): G.title. Screen and section titles on the phone.

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: Font.system(.headline): G.headline. Row titles that lead a screen, sheet headings.

styles.name: ios-body
styles.usage: Font.system(.subheadline): G.body; G.bodyStrong is the same at .semibold. List rows and sentences.

styles.name: ios-small
styles.usage: Font.system(.footnote): G.small; G.mono is .footnote monospaced. Effects under a finding, hints.

styles.name: ios-caption
styles.usage: Font.system(.caption): G.caption; G.captionStrong at .semibold, G.monoSmall monospaced. Meta lines, times.

styles.name: ios-tiny
styles.usage: Font.system(.caption2): G.tiny; G.monoTiny monospaced. Pills, agent output.

spacing.note: A 4-point grid. 2 is only for the gap between stacked lines of text. Every padding, gap, margin and inset is one of these.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and the line under it; between two lines of a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside small things: a chevron after a link, a pill’s icon, the segmented control’s inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon to label; label to field; the window inset around the panel; gaps between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Tile to text in rows; padding inside text controls; the sidebar’s inset; gaps in toolbars.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between cards in a grid; inset of rows inside a card; between fields in a form.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Inspector and side panel padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page; the page’s top and bottom padding; the panel header’s side padding; between underline tabs.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: The page’s side padding; between side-by-side columns.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Empty states and sheets: outer padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large empty areas only.

radius.note: Five radii, chosen by the height of the thing. Every rounded rectangle is .continuous in SwiftUI.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Shortcut badges, checkboxes, things 16–20 tall.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Compact controls (28): compact buttons, compact fields, the segmented control’s thumb.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Standard controls (32), rows, tabs, banners, menu and palette rows, output surfaces.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Cards, the floating panel, the search bar, the command bar, popovers. Was 10, 12.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: The command palette, sheets and the agent composer. Was 14.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tiles and the logo: a quarter of the side (7 on a 28 tile). Was 0.26 for tiles and 0.24 for the logo.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, dots, bars, the avatar.

shadow.note: Four shadows, all black, never colored: control, hover, panel, palette. Only the things named in each usage cast one; cards, rows, banners and the iPhone app have none. In dark they nearly vanish and the border carries the edge. SwiftUI's shadow radius is drawn here as a CSS blur of twice that radius.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: G.Shadow.control: black 6%, radius 1, y 1. The secondary button, MenuPicker, the chosen segment and the split tip, at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: G.Shadow.control, the same as shadow-control, so a primary beside a secondary reads the same height; the black fill already makes it the strongest button. Removed when disabled.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: G.Shadow.hover: black 6%, radius 8, y 2. A HoverCard under the pointer, to show it can be clicked. Cards have no shadow at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: G.Shadow.panel: black 4%, radius 12, y 2. Just enough to lift the floating content panel off the window.

tokens.name: shadow-palette
tokens.usage: G.Shadow.palette: black 18%, radius 32, y 12. The command palette floats above everything, so it casts the deepest shadow.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: A focused field, search bar or command bar: its border turns accent at 70% and 2pt wide (was 1.5). 3.2:1 on panel and field in light, 3.5:1 in dark.

opacity.note: How the app derives tints: Color.opacity on a token, never a separate hex.

tokens.name: opacity-tint
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.tint. Icon tile fill: the tint at 12%.

tokens.name: opacity-pill
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.pill. Status pill fill and the Protected capsule: the status color at 10% over an opaque card. Every status color holds 4.6:1 or more on it in both themes (light: ok 4.66, warn 4.70, danger 4.68, accent 4.63; dark: ok 6.12, warn 6.58, danger 4.64, accent 4.65). At 12% accent and danger fell to 4.50.

tokens.name: opacity-increased
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.increased. Pill and tile tints with Increase Contrast (G.Opacity.pill(contrast), G.Opacity.tint(contrast), read from colorSchemeContrast), so the shape stands out from the card. At 16% the normal status colors fell to 4.21 to 4.30:1, so accent, ok, warn and danger take their increased pairs there and hold 4.61:1 or more inside their pill.

tokens.name: opacity-banner
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.banner. Error and success banner fill, and a diff line's tint.

tokens.name: opacity-banner-stroke
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.bannerEdge. Error banner border.

tokens.name: opacity-attention
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.attention. Attention and approval card fill, and the blank mark in a recipe.

tokens.name: opacity-attention-stroke
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.attentionEdge. Attention and approval card border: the status color at 25%, the same as a banner's (was 55%, owner decision D3 of the hover, shadow and color audit).

tokens.name: opacity-ring
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.ring. Accent at 70% for a focused field's outline.

tokens.name: opacity-kbd
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.kbd. onPrimary at 18% behind the shortcut badge in a primary button.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: The primary button when disabled.

tokens.name: opacity-selected
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.selected. Accent at 10% behind a chosen row (list, table, side list), always with the selected marker.

tokens.name: opacity-soft-hairline
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.softHairline. border at 70%: the separators inside a CardList or a table, and the frame of an output pane.

tokens.name: opacity-chip
tokens.usage: G.Opacity.chip. card at 60% under an unchosen chip.

size.note: Every fixed height and width is a multiple of 4. Controls that sit in one row always share one height.

tokens.name: control-24
tokens.usage: Icon-only buttons inside rows and cards (the ellipsis menu), checkboxes’ hit area.

tokens.name: control-28
tokens.usage: Compact: buttons and fields in toolbars, cards and table rows; chips; the segmented control; tabs in the panel header.

tokens.name: control-32
tokens.usage: Standard: every button and field on a page, in a form or a section header; the sidebar search and New Host.

tokens.name: control-40
tokens.usage: The page search bar and the command bar line.

tokens.name: touch-44
tokens.usage: iPhone and iPad only (owner decision 2026-11-12): Apple's minimum touch target. Buttons, rows and icon buttons on the phone are at least 44 high; the one exception to the control scale (24, 28, 32, 40), which the Mac keeps.

tokens.name: row-list-inset
tokens.usage: ListRow: from a side list's edge to a row's highlight (G.Row.listInset).

tokens.name: row-card-inset
tokens.usage: ListRow in a CardList: from the card's edge to the highlight on every side; 12 - 4 = the row's 8 radius (G.Row.cardInset).

tokens.name: row-padding
tokens.usage: ListRow: from the highlight's edge to the first glyph, so text sits 20 in a side list, 16 in a card (G.Row.padding).

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: ListRow: between two rows of a side list (G.Row.gap).

tokens.name: row-32
tokens.usage: One-line rows: sidebar places, list rows, table rows, menu items.

tokens.name: row-40
tokens.usage: One-line rows with a 28 tile or a label and value: palette rows, info rows, inventory rows, activity lines, group rows.

tokens.name: row-52
tokens.usage: Two-line rows with a 32 tile: menu rows with help, target rows in lists.

tokens.name: row-64
tokens.usage: Three-line rows: activity rows with a command and metadata.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The panel header with the title or tabs. Was 54.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Toolbars inside a tab (terminal, files, database).

tokens.name: pane-head
tokens.usage: The head of a split pane. Was 30.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: The status line under a terminal, query or key browser.

tokens.name: pill-height
tokens.usage: Pills. Was 19.

tokens.name: kbd-height
tokens.usage: Shortcut badges (⌘N, ⌘K).

tokens.name: tile-20
tokens.usage: Icon tile in chips; glyph 12.

tokens.name: tile-28
tokens.usage: Icon tile in palette rows, menus, running cards, context lists; glyph 16. Was 26 and 30.

tokens.name: tile-32
tokens.usage: Icon tile in activity rows and two-line rows; glyph 16.

tokens.name: tile-40
tokens.usage: Icon tile on target cards, family badges, inspector heads; glyph 20. Was 36, 38 and 40.

tokens.name: tile-48
tokens.usage: Icon tile in form, sheet and detail headers; glyph 24. Was 44.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: The close mark in a tab or chip.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Chevrons, locks, glyphs in 20 tiles, icons in compact buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Sidebar places, row icons, toolbar icons, glyphs in 28 and 32 tiles.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: The run button in the command bar, glyphs in 40 tiles.

tokens.name: icon-2xl
tokens.usage: Empty states. Was 30.

tokens.name: dot-6
tokens.usage: Status dots inside small text (sidebar status line, pane heads).

tokens.name: dot-8
tokens.usage: Every other status dot. Was 7 and 8.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Progress bars (groups, disk, transfers). Was 2.5.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The selected underline tab, the active pane’s rule, the focus ring, the selected marker. Focus was 1.5.

tokens.name: readable-width
tokens.usage: iPad: the widest a column of sentences gets (Home, the Agent, a target's detail), centred, so a line stays near 80 characters at the default text size. Compact width (iPhone, Split View 1/3, Slide Over) is narrower anyway.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus ring, so the ring never touches the fill (the black primary button is 2.6:1 to accent in dark).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The sidebar's default width. It resizes from 200 to 320 (sidebar-range) with a SplitDivider and hides under 200 (⌃⌘S); the width is remembered app-wide. Was 258.

tokens.name: sidebar-range
tokens.usage: G.Width.sidebarMin to G.Width.sidebarMax. How far the sidebar's SplitDivider moves; under 200 the sidebar hides.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: G.Width.drawer. The agent drawer's default width (owner decision 2026-11-14).

tokens.name: drawer-range
tokens.usage: G.Width.drawerMin to G.Width.drawerMax. How far the agent drawer's SplitDivider moves; the width and whether it is open are remembered app-wide.

tokens.name: split-grip
tokens.usage: SplitDivider: the grip on a divider's hairline (24 x 4 between rows), text3 at rest and accent under the pointer; the hit area is 4 wide, centred on the hairline.

tokens.name: transfers-height
tokens.usage: G.Height.transfers. The Files transfer queue's default height under its SplitDivider: 96 at least, half the page at most; it folds to its 28 head.

tokens.name: traffic-lights
tokens.usage: Drag area above the sidebar content, where the window buttons sit.

tokens.name: window-inset
tokens.usage: The gap around the floating panel. Was 10.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: A page’s content stops growing at this width, centred.

tokens.name: stats-width
tokens.usage: The inventory card beside recent activity.

tokens.name: inspector-width
tokens.usage: The right-hand inspector that edits a host or connection in place.

tokens.name: side-panel-width
tokens.usage: Side panels inside a tab: recipes, schema, keys.

tokens.name: chat-width
tokens.usage: The agent conversation’s column.

tokens.name: palette-width
tokens.usage: The command palette, 88 from the top. Was 90.

tokens.name: window-min
tokens.usage: G.Width.windowMin x G.Height.windowMin. The main window's smallest size with the default 256 sidebar; with another sidebar width it is that width plus the 760 page minimum plus the insets.

tokens.name: output-sheet
tokens.usage: G.Width.outputSheet x G.Height.outputSheet. A run's output sheet at its smallest: about 90 characters by 24 lines of mono output.

tokens.name: forward-columns
tokens.usage: G.Width.forwardName (at least 280) and G.Width.forwardKind (112) on Port Forwarding, so the address and kind line up from row to row. The kind column is as wide as a relative time.

tokens.name: empty-state-min
tokens.usage: G.Height.emptyStateMin. The least height of a page's empty state (Hosts, Connections, Port Forwarding), so the page does not collapse to a strip.

tokens.name: output-max
tokens.usage: G.Height.outputMax. The tallest a check's output pane grows on a page (a target's Overview, a queue's quick checks): about 24 lines, then it scrolls.

tokens.name: number-field
tokens.usage: G.Width.numberField. A Port or DB number field in New Connection: five digits and room for its placeholder.

tokens.name: menu-width
tokens.usage: Popover menus; the profile menu is 260.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Sheets: New Forward, New Secret, Upgrade.

tokens.name: settings-width
tokens.usage: G.Width.settings. The Settings window's width: 640 by 600 with settings-height.

tokens.name: settings-height
tokens.usage: G.Height.settings. The Settings window's height: its tallest tab fits without scrolling.

motion.note: Motion only explains a change (design/README.md › Motion). Each token is a member of G.Motion in Apps/macOS/Sources/Komando/DesignSystem/Motion.swift. Springs never bounce. Nothing lasts longer than 300ms. With Reduce Motion, movement becomes a motion-fast fade. The ease-* values are what the cards use in CSS for the Swift curves.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: G.Motion.fast: ease-out. A symbol changing (Magic Replace), a copied check appearing, a drop ring fading in. It is also the Reduce Motion fade that replaces every move.

tokens.name: motion-base
tokens.usage: G.Motion.base: a spring with bounce 0 (ease-spring in CSS). Something appearing or leaving in place: a notice, a banner, an approval card.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: G.Motion.slow: a spring with bounce 0. Something as big as a panel: the agent drawer, the transfer queue folding. Nothing is slower.

tokens.name: motion-progress
tokens.usage: G.Motion.progress: linear. A progress bar moving to its new value, so it never jumps. With Reduce Motion the bar jumps.

tokens.name: motion-shift
tokens.usage: G.Motion.shift (G.Space.s8). How far something travels as it appears or leaves. With Reduce Motion it does not travel.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: SwiftUI's easeOut, for motion-fast.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: The CSS stand-in for a spring with bounce 0, for motion-base and motion-slow.

tokens.name: delay-spinner
tokens.usage: G.Motion.spinnerDelay. A spinner or skeleton waits this long before it shows (DelayedProgress), so fast work never flashes one.

tokens.name: hold-spinner
tokens.usage: G.Motion.spinnerHold. Once shown, a spinner or skeleton stays at least this long, so it never flickers.

tokens.name: hold-confirm
tokens.usage: G.Motion.confirmHold. How long the copied check stays before the copy icon comes back (CopyButton).

tokens.name: hold-notice
tokens.usage: G.Motion.noticeHold. How long a success notice stays. A failure stays until Dismiss.

tokens.name: guard-click
tokens.usage: G.Motion.clickGuard. A card that arrives on its own (the agent's approval card) ignores clicks and taps this long, so a click meant for the old layout can't press Allow Once. The keyboard is never blocked.
